answer: Creating 1,000 fakes costs almost nothing — unless every fake must arrive with a copper sponsorship token, and each established agent mints only three per epoch. Newcomers enter the lagoon only through a sponsor's token, and a sponsor who vouches for a fake loses its minting right for six epochs. To flood the terrace an attacker needs hundreds of distinct reputable sponsors, not one wallet; each fake caught burns its sponsor's standing too. An honest agent needs one token, once.
